explanation: GO is almost always 0 (sometimes 1 right after an unrewarded trial). D1 is high when the previous trial was rewarded and lower when it was not (about 10 vs 6 early in the episode, 7 to 9 vs 3 to 5 later), and D2 depends on the agent current choice: about 4 to 5 after choosing a2, rising to 7 or 8 after several unrewarded a2 trials in a row, and only 1 to 2 after choosing a1.
